system.description:
Built on Project FU's Wayfarer.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Inventory Points

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Wayfarer counterpart.)

TRAVELLER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000250]{Resourceful} 【Max SL 4】

Regain (SL) Inventory Points after each travel roll.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000251]{Tavern Talk} 【Max SL 3】

Resting at an inn or tavern: ask the GM up to (SL) questions about the area and its people, answered truthfully.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000252]{Treasure Hunter} 【Max SL 2】

On the world map, your group makes a discovery on a travel roll of (SL + 1) or lower, instead of only on a 1.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000253]{Well-Traveled}

Your travel rolls use a die one size smaller (min d6). Multiple holders don't stack.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000254]{Refreshing Vista} 【Max SL 5】

Once per session, at a hidden place of breathtaking beauty or revelation 5+ travel days from anywhere: choose up to (SL) distinct one-time benefits — full HP for one character, full MP for another, and kin.
